info.title: TestArmy API
info.description: AI-powered browser automation API for QA testing. Automate web testing workflows using natural language prompts.

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication using Bearer token format

code.description: JavaScript run in the browser page. Runs as an awaited function body; passes if it completes without throwing (returns nothing or { success: true }) and fails if it returns { success: false, reason } or throws. Web tests only.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page

deviceModel.description: Non-default mobile device variant within the run platform (e.g. ipad on iOS). Null means the platform default phone-sized device; explicitly requested defaults are stored as null.

output.description: Run output when completed or skipped

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the QA agent

focusAreas.description: Focus areas derived from changed files

changeType.description: Classify this PR: frontend = UI/component changes, backend = API/DB/service changes with no visible UI effect, mixed = both, infra = CI/config/docs only

title.description: Concise description of what to do or verify
Concise description of what to do or verify
Concise description of the login step

credentialId.description: ID of the credential to use

temporaryEmail.description: Set to true to create a temporary email inbox at run time

title.description: Description of what page state to capture

type.description: Capture visual evidence of the current page state

steps.description: Ordered list of concrete test steps the agent must execute one-by-one

executionConfig.description: Pre-run execution configuration selected by the planner.

stepResults.description: Step-level results for structured test runs

userName.description: Display name of the user who triggered the run

externalRef.description: External integration metadata (e.g. GitHub PR/deployment IDs)

executionMode.description: Execution mode used for this run

autoRetryCount.description: Number of times the run was automatically retried after a temporary failure. Failed attempts are not counted toward usage.

featureName.description: Name of the feature being tested

result.description: Test result - PASS if no issues found, FAILED if any issues were reported

description.description: Short summary of what was tested and the final result; include a compact grouped issue summary only when the user explicitly asks for one

issues.description: Issues reported during the session via the report_issue tool

screenshots.description: Array of screenshot URLs captured during testing

type.description: issue = confirmed bug, warning = non-blocking observation

name.description: Short name of the issue (e.g. 'Login form rejects valid email')

description.description: What was tested, what happened, and what was expected

reproductionSteps.description: Short reproduction steps in execution order

tMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the recording reference time when the issue was reported

startedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step started

completedAtMs.description: Milliseconds elapsed since recording reference when the step completed
